items.description: Disposal of shed roof timber and broken glass pane
items.rationale: Remains of insured property, material arising under 5.2.1(a); both elements indemnifiable so the combined line is fine. Reference prices: timber below 75, glass about 32, giving roughly 90.

items.description: Combined load: green waste, root mass over 1 m3, excavated soil
items.rationale: Combined position mixing indemnifiable green waste with a root mass over 1 m3 (5.2.1(e)) and ground material (5.2.1(d)); 7.1.10 declines the whole line.
Ground material under 5.2.1(d); standalone clearance without reinstatement or making good, so not indemnified under 5.2.2.
Ground material however processed, 5.2.1(d); 5.2.2 conditions not met since no reinstatement ground works and ground not made good.
